primitives.note: 4-shot magazine with 2.5s reload gates all basic-attack damage output
Jhin's 4th basic attack, and each Curtain Call's 4th recast, are empowered
4th basic shot and 4th Curtain Call shot always crit; passive halves crit damage multiplier and fixes attack speed so crit chance feeds the AD-conversion instead
4th basic shot bonus damage and Curtain Call bullet damage both scale with target's missing health
Every Moment Matters converts level, bonus crit chance and bonus attack speed into bonus AD
Jhin's attack speed is fixed except by leveling; bonus AS from items is instead read by the stat-conversion term, not applied to attack interval
Q, W and E deal on-cast/short-delay damage on cooldown
Q's bounce needs additional nearby unhit enemies; E's trap needs an enemy to walk into it - both assume behavior against a single stationary dummy
grenade damage amplifies 35% (stacking) if a hit enemy dies before the next bounce
mana costs (and E's separate charge/recharge system) limit casts over 15s
Lotus Trap slows for 2s then detonates for its damage - a delayed single payload rather than instant
Curtain Call channels for up to 10s, blocking some other actions
up to 4 separately-timed recasts each dealing their own damage instance

needsBespoke.why: The kit is unusual (ammo/reload cycle, a stat-conversion passive AD formula gated by level/crit/AS, a channel with four independently-scaling recasts, missing-health scaling on two different abilities) but each piece maps onto an existing primitive; no mechanic requires logic outside the closed list.

unsettled.question: In a single-stationary-dummy fight, does Dancing Grenade's bounce (which 'prioritizes the closest enemy that has not been hit') re-hit the same dummy for additional instances, or fail to bounce since no unhit enemy exists, effectively landing as a single hit?
options: Grenade bounces back onto the same dummy for up to 3 extra hits (each potentially gaining the 35%-on-kill amp if the dummy is treated as never dying)
Grenade only ever lands its first hit against a lone target; the bounce mechanic and its damage amp never trigger
quotes: can bounce to up to three additional nearby enemies, prioritizing the closest enemy that has not been hit

unsettled.question: Does Curtain Call's 3%-per-1%-missing-health damage amplification apply to the already-doubled 4th ('critical') bullet, or is the 4th-shot figure in the wiki's leveling table (AD*2, base*2) the complete formula with the missing-health term applied only to bullets 1-3?
options: Missing-health amp multiplies the 4th bullet's base+AD damage as well, i.e. total multiplier = 2 x (1 + 3xmissingFraction)
Missing-health amp only applies to normal (non-4th) Curtain Call bullets; the 4th bullet uses a flat 2x multiplier with no missing-health scaling
quotes: Damage to enemies hit, increased by ... 3% per 1% of target's missing health
The fourth shot critically strikes for {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} damage.

unsettled.question: Does channeling Curtain Call lock Jhin out of basic attacks (his ammo-based DPS) for the full up-to-10s channel, or does the channel effectively end once the 4th shot is fired (freeing him to resume attacking sooner)?
options: Channel occupies Jhin until either the 4th recast fires or 10s elapses, whichever first, then normal actions resume
Channel is a hard 10s lockout on non-recast actions regardless of how many shots were fired
quotes: '''Jhin''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, transforming his weapon into a cannon and gaining the ability to recast ''Curtain Call'' 4 times within the duration.

unsettled.question: Against a stationary target dummy that never moves, does a Lotus Trap placed on/under the dummy still 'bloom' and detonate (treating the dummy as already crossing/being in its radius once armed), or does the trap require the target to walk into it and thus never trigger on an immobile target?
options: Trap triggers as soon as it finishes arming if the dummy is already standing in its radius, dealing its damage on a fixed delay
Trap never triggers against a target that never moves into it, making E's damage unusable in the dummy fight
quotes: becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second... The ''Lotus Trap blooms'' upon enemy contact

unsettled.question: How long can Jhin go without attacking/casting before the out-of-combat auto-reload timer starts: the wiki's stated 10 seconds, or the bin's OutOfCombatTimeBeforeReload = 8?
quotes: withholding leftover rounds after 10 seconds of being [[out of combat]]

proposal: Open with Deadly Flourish (W) as the first action for its guaranteed physical damage while it's off cooldown and mana is full.
Throw Dancing Grenade (Q) on cooldown throughout the fight for its base physical damage.
Weave continuous basic attacks between ability casts, respecting the 4-shot magazine and 2.5s reload, so every 4th shot lands (always crits, includes the missing-health execute bonus).
Place Lotus Trap (E) whenever a charge is available and mana allows, accepting the source-uncertainty about whether it can trigger on a stationary dummy.

Cast Curtain Call (R) once mana and cooldown allow, then recast it as fast as its 1s static per-shot cooldown permits to land all 4 bullets (including the empowered 4th) before resuming the basic-attack/Q/W/E rotation.

Keep Q, W, R off cooldown as much as mana permits for the remainder of the 15s window; treat E as opportunistic given its long per-charge recharge (14-24s) and the uncertainty over whether it deals damage at all in this fight.
questions: Does Curtain Call lock out basic attacks and Q/W/E casts for its full channel duration, and if so, is it still worth using early (for its own high burst) versus saving it to not eat into the ammo-based attack window?
Is E worth including in the optimal rotation at all against a stationary target dummy, or should it be omitted from the damage-fight rotation entirely?

At what level/item state is this rotation evaluated - does Jhin have enough mana to cast Q, W, E and R at their stated costs across a full 15s rotation, or does mana become the binding constraint before cooldowns do?
Does the simulator treat Dancing Grenade's bounce as landing extra hits on the sole target, and if so, how many (up to 3, per NumberOfBounces)?
